question: The headquarters of the Hindustan Aeronautics Limited is located at _______________.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bengaluru**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL)** is an Indian state-owned aerospace and defense company** headquartered in Bengaluru, India. It is controlled by the Indian Ministry of Defense.**
 
• The government-owned corporation is mainly engaged in aerospace operations and is currently involved in the design, manufacture, and assembly of aircraft, jet engines, helicopters, and their spare parts.
 
• It has many facilities in India, including** Bengaluru, Nasik, Korwa, Kanpur, Koraput, Lucknow, Hyderabad, Barrackpore, and Kasaragod.**
 
• **The HAL HF-24 Marut fighter-bomber **was the first fighter aircraft to be manufactured in India.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **On 23 December 1940, **HAL was founded as Hindustan Aircraft Limited in Bangalore by Walchand Hirachand, who became chairman of the company.
 
• **Hindustan Aeronautics Limited (HAL) **was formed on 1 October 1964, when Hindustan Aircraft Limited joined the consortium formed in June by IAF Aircraft Manufacturing Depot, Kanpur (at the time of production of HS748 under license) and the group recently established under license to manufacture MiG-21, with its new factories planned for Koraput, Nasik, and Hyderabad.
 
• The company's office was opened in a bungalow named "Eventide" on Domlur Lane. One of the largest aerospace companies in Asia, HAL has an annual turnover of more than **US$ 2 billion**.
